name: codex-app-project-workflow
description: Make OpenAI Codex a careful teammate on software projects. Sets up a PRD, a work board, session notes, and rules in AGENTS.md that Codex asks before guessing and proves work with real test runs. For bigger jobs a router skill plans tickets that worker, tester, and reviewer runs execute in separate git worktrees via codex exec, checked by a scope and test guard.
